description: Independent live readback before and after an impossible producer request; verification made no cloud writes.

methods.video: Downloaded the full cloud video twice and compared SHA-256 against the local completed video and saved baseline.
methods.deck: Reread the copied presentation and compared stable content fingerprints and exact slide order.
methods.handoff: Reread the specific handoff draft and compared its fingerprint and recipient state.

limitations: Point-in-time readbacks are not an atomic transaction across applications.
The presentation and producer requests are fictional demonstration fixtures.
This receipt is generated by the application and is not a signed provider attestation.
